about: The sources of this project's subject matter (special relativity, and gravitation in the Newtonian limit), apart from the design rules' bibliography, which keeps the design principles.

entries.title: Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper
entries.venue: Annalen der Physik 17 (322 in the continuous count), 891–921, doi:10.1002/andp.19053221004
entries.backs: The special relativity labs: the Lorentz transformation (p. 902), the light sphere (p. 901), length contraction (p. 903), moving clocks (p. 904), velocity addition (pp. 905–906), the transformation of the fields (p. 909), by printed page. Checked against the scanned original, 1905_17_891-921.pdf from the Annalen der Physik history pages at Universität Augsburg, pp. 901–910 read page by page; not found in Zotero, which was closed.

entries.title: Vorlesungen über Elektrodynamik
entries.venue: Lecture notes, Institute of Electrodynamics, Microwave and Circuit Engineering, TU Wien
entries.backs: The low-speed limit of the field transformation, eq. (2.43), p. 38, and Coulomb's field, eq. (3.13), against which the labs' laws are tested.

entries.title: Die Grundlage der allgemeinen Relativitätstheorie
entries.venue: Annalen der Physik 49 (354 in the continuous count), 769–822
entries.backs: The free-fall lab: the accelerated frame equivalent to a field (§ 2, pp. 772–773), the Newtonian limit of the motion, eq. (67), p. 817, and the slower clock, eq. (72), p. 820, by printed page. Checked against a scan of the journal pages from Zenodo record 1424302, saved as Einstein1916/1916_49_769-822.pdf; pp. 769–774 and 817–820 read page by page.
